dedupe_keys.name: ipen mb 01 subcritical neutron noise spectra

description: APSD_Data contains raw measurements from subcritical neutron-noise experiments at the IPEN/MB-01 research reactor in Brazil. The IPEN team publishes separate file groups for reactor-water natural-boron concentrations of 286.8 and 578.6 ppm. The README reports corresponding subcritical reactivities of minus 8.95 and minus 17.43 dollars and spectra measured up to 100 kHz. It states that a four-mode decay model best described the spectra up to about 70 kHz, which is a narrower fitted range than the measured range. The two experiment directories are freely accessible on GitHub under the repository Apache 2.0 licence. Individual payload formats and temporal coverage were not established from the root inventory. These are measurements from one research-reactor configuration, so they do not directly represent commercial plant operating conditions. A reviewer-assessed use is benchmarking reactor-noise or neutron-transport simulations, with model-openmc as a related particle-transport resource. No transport calculation or spectral fit was run during this review.
name: IPEN/MB-01 subcritical neutron-noise spectra
notes: G2 G2-0028. Metadata-only review. Simulation uses and cross-resource relations are reviewer assessments. No data or archive downloaded and no simulation run.
